modeReason: Several top stories clear the relevance threshold of 8: a lab cutting ties with safety researchers over a records dispute amid a separate regulatory probe into AI product risks, a datacenter operator's tax-avoidance story, and a chatbot's reported role in a government's military decision each score 18.
phrase: A company that promised to police itself just cut ties with three safety researchers over a records dispute. Regulators are separately investigating the industry over product risks.
phraseAlternatives: A lab lost three safety researchers in a records dispute. A regulator is separately reviewing the industry's product risks.
The company that pledged to police itself just has three fewer safety researchers, over a dispute about records.
A safety team got smaller after a records dispute. Elsewhere, a government review of the industry's products goes on.
Three safety researchers are gone over a records dispute. The industry's self-policing pledge stayed the same size.

brief.concept: A robot in a lab coat carries a box of folders labeled records out through a door on one side of a dividing line, while on the other side a taller official robot with a clipboard inspects a row of consoles.
brief.metaphor: Internal housekeeping and outside oversight happening on separate tracks, not one causing the other.
cast: a robot wearing a lab coat, carrying a box of folders
a taller official robot holding a clipboard
a row of consoles with status lights
a small government building icon in the background
brief.composition: A thin vertical divider splits the panel. Left half: a robot in a lab coat walks toward a door carrying a box labeled 'records', neutral expression, not looking back. Right half: a taller robot with a clipboard inspects a row of three consoles with status lights, a small government-building icon in the far corner. Warm cream background, flat shapes in blue and fluorescent pink ink only, thick friendly outlines.
brief.alt: A robot in a lab coat carries a box labeled records out a door on one side of a dividing line. On the other side, a taller robot with a clipboard inspects a row of consoles below a small government building icon.
